{{CSGO}}: 2015-01-13 }} '''Team Liquid''' is a professional esports organization founded in the [[:category:Netherlands|Netherlands]] in 2000. Originally a ''[[starcraft:StarCraft|StarCraft: Brood War]]'' clan, the team switched to ''[[starcraft2:StarCraft|StarCraft II]]'' during the beta in 2010, and became one of the most successful foreign teams.
